title: Intro Cut
howto: Drop a video into mpv. Press l to mark the start, l again to mark the end, then Shift+X to export.
exportTo: Exports join the %1 backgrounds and play when you switch to this theme or log in.
noTheme: No current theme found. Exports go to ~/Pictures/Intros.
mpv.conflict: ~/.config/mpv/scripts/intro-cut.lua is a regular file, so the plugin's copy is not linked. Remove it to let the plugin manage it.
introsOff: Background intros are turned off. Enable them with: omarchy theme bg intro enable
error: Could not read the theme's intros.
empty: This theme has no backgrounds with an intro yet.
footer.keys: R refresh · M open mpv · Esc close
